experiment_Name: Method B v36 CODE-ACCORD full document, matched cases
experiment_Description: Controlled non-direct-QA comparison, Method B. The full PDF text is ingested and ranked; the whole document is not sent in one prompt. v36 uses its v35 single-pass baseline plus five-tool ReAct controller, four steps, a 6000 output-token budget, a three-consecutive-malformed-call limit, and baseline fallback. Per-run traces report finalized improvements, harmful revisions, unchanged fallbacks, tool failures, tokens, and runtime. This configuration filters the 292-record full dataset to the 290 filenames in the expanded-passage reference set; source-match status and PDF metadata remain available. Uses Gemma 4 31B, temperature 1.0, five repetitions. Historical Exp. 73's aggregate includes fallbacks and does not isolate finalized revisions.
